_meta.source: CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Sheet 14 of 26
_meta.verified_by: Ryan, June 5 2026, manual extraction from diagram
_meta.purpose: validation fixture for Conestruct shoulder closure outputs against CDOT typical applications

legend_symbols.star: see Fines Double Signing Notes on Sheet 12 (operational rules, 250' min spacing flexibility)
legend_symbols.triangle_solid: optional device — contractor judgment per traffic volumes/scope; required when included in Schedule of Construction Control Devices
legend_symbols.hexagon_solid: required when work occupies the location more than 3 days

case_26.title: Shoulder Work - Freeway/Expressway w/ 65 mph Speed Limit
case_26.trigger_condition: WHEN HAZARDS (WORKERS, EQUIPMENT, OR TEMPORARY BARRIER) ARE WITHIN 8 FT OF TRAVEL WAY

taper.notes: L/3 is labeled on diagram. Actual length depends on shoulder width W.

buffer_space.interpretation: CDOT supplement uses 570 ft minimum at 65 mph; MUTCD Table 6C-2 federal value is 645 ft. CDOT supplement is more permissive. Conestruct should emit the CDOT value when CO supplement governs.

work_zone.interpretation: Work zone length shown as 0.5L on diagram is illustrative only; actual work zone length is input parameter

channelizing_devices.callout_text: CHANNELIZING DEVICES OR TEMPORARY BARRIER (LIGHTS OPTIONAL)
channelizing_devices.actual_taper_device_count_rule: depends on actual taper length (1/3 L) and §6C.09 max spacing (≤ S ft in taper = ≤ 65 ft at 65 mph)
channelizing_devices.diagram_concrete_barrier_distribution: 2 before work zone, 5 in work zone, 1 after; ambiguous whether all 8 are conceptually 'in' work zone

plaques.selection_rule: contractor picks one of the three based on situation

advance_warning_sequence.frequency_note: TO BE PROVIDED EVERY 2640' OR THE SPACING OF THE SIGNS MAY BE CHANGED AS DIRECTED BY THE ENGINEER BETWEEN R2-10 AND R2-11 SIGNS

plaques.selection_rule: X is contractor-filled based on work zone length

exact_match_required: all sign codes in advance_warning_sequence and downstream_sequence
posted speed values (65 normal, 60 work zone)
presence of W7-3aP(X) plaque under second W21-5aR
presence of one-of-three W16 plaques under first W21-5aR
buffer space minimum (570' per CDOT supplement)
annotation_match_recommended: flashing beacon presence on sunburst-marked signs
fines double sign treatment per star marker
optional device handling per triangle marker
informational_only_not_assertions: diagram taper device count (8) — actual count by §6C.09 spacing rules
diagram concrete barrier count (8) — illustrative only
diagram work zone length (0.5L) — illustrative only, actual length is input
